heavyScan.l16Occupant: atoms-store pipeline apply Bexar 48029 (NOT PostGIS plan scan on CORTEX)

design.digestCrossCheck: Where L15 *.summary.json exists with planDigest.sha256, new plan-only digest MUST equal it. Mismatch = FINDING (data change or nondeterminism).

budgetsSec.haltAt: 1.5x expected wall; then EXPLAIN, do not queue-wait

design.verdictPredicate: Judge by written summary/NDJSON contents (planDigest + mode=plan-only + atomsWritten=0). NEVER fail because stdout mentions --apply hint text.

cp2Gate: Smoke 48261 plan-only lands NDJSON; digest matches L15 summary; format=flood-plan-ndjson-v1; then start metro serial.
